reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that notifies users when model replies finish, using the current user message or session title as notification text and deduplicating notifications per turn.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中，模型回复完成时发送系统级 Web 通知，并使用当前用户消息或会话标题作为通知内容。
summaries.en: Sends a system-level web notification when a model reply finishes in the DeepSeek Harness web interface, using the current user message or session title as the notification text.

capabilities: Displays system-level web notifications when replies complete
Reads the current turn's user message text or session title for notification content
Monitors reply completion across open sessions
